motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of the July 8, 2025, Planning Commission Meeting. Commissioner Strong secon…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to approve the minutes of the July 8, 2025, Planning Commission Meeting. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: July 8 minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of its July 8, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: This is record-keeping only, and nobody outside the room is touched by it.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Consolidated Free Schedule, excluding any references to illegal dumping and tabling the illegal dumping section until the next Planning Commission Meeting. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: City fee schedule update sent to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended the council adopt changes to the city's consolidated fee schedule, except the illegal dumping section, which it held for its next meeting.
motions.impact: The motion lists no fee amounts, so what you might pay is not in the record. The council decides, and the dumping section returns to the commission first.

motions.item_title: Table Item 7.B, Animal, Exceptions, Public Hearings, and Appeals Code Amendment until the next…
motions.motion: Commissioner Strong moved to table Item 7.B, Animal, Exceptions, Public Hearings, and Appeals Code Amendment until the next Planning Commission Meeting, to give the Staff to revisit the Animal, ADU, and Home Business tables. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Animal, ADU and home business rules held over
motions.summary: The commission tabled a code change on animals, exceptions, public hearings and appeals until its next meeting so staff could revisit tables for animals, ADUs and home businesses.
motions.impact: Nothing changed. If you keep animals, rent out an accessory apartment or run a business from home, watch for this item when it returns.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.C., Preliminary Plat Code Amendment. Commissio…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.C., Preliminary Plat Code Amendment. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change to preliminary plat rules recommended
motions.summary: A matching change for preliminary plats, the early lot layouts a developer submits, also won the commission's recommendation to the council.
motions.impact: This is for people applying to build subdivisions. Homeowners won't notice it, and the council still has to act.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Final Plat Code Amendment. Commissioner Al…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., Final Plat Code Amendment. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Change to final plat rules recommended
motions.summary: The commission recommended a change to the city code on final plats, the recorded maps that divide land into lots, and sent it to the council.
motions.impact: Developers dividing land would follow the new rules if the council adopts them. The motion does not describe what changes.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., Brylee Commercial Lot 3 Site Plan. Commiss…
motions.motion: Commissioner Whiting moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., Brylee Commercial Lot 3 Site Plan. Commissioner Strong seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Brylee Commercial Lot 3 site plan backed
motions.summary: The commission recommended the council approve the site plan for Lot 3 of Brylee Commercial and attached no conditions.
motions.impact: The record doesn't say what would be built on the lot. The council votes next.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.F., Pony Express Medical with the two conditio…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.F., Pony Express Medical with the two conditions that the red lines on the landscape plan have or will be made, as well as the identifications on the plans for the architectural exterior treatments to be completed. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Pony Express Medical plans sent to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended the council approve Pony Express Medical on two conditions: the landscape plan corrections get made, and the plans identify the building's exterior finishes.
motions.impact: The City Council has the final say. Until it votes, the project has no green light.
